hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"); print(f)" | grep -q "\.py$" && FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"))") && ruff check --fix "$FILE" && ruff format "$FILE" || true'
